[[File:Vonport.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vonport]]
'''Vonport''' was a major spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]]. The crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' docked here during their search for [[Dass Jennir]]. The city was garrisoned with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] when they arrived, but they managed to get through without much trouble. [[Beyghor Sahdett]], [[Bomo Greenbark]], [[Meekerdin-maa]], and [[Ko Vakier]] later [[Mission to Vondarc|raided]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] guard station to hack into the Empire's [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] for clues on Jennir. The information they recovered led them to the desert world of [[Prine]], where they indeed found who they were looking for.
